title: Optimize local agent prompts and tool descriptions for absolute autonomy
body:
This PR addresses the user's objective to audit, analyze, and optimize the behavior of AI agents (specifically targeting the local LM Studio and Langchain.js implementations) to guarantee strict zero-friction autonomy, preventing them from falling into "help-seeking" loops.

The changes involve:
1.  **Prompt Engineering Optimization**: Tweaked the `ChatPromptTemplate` in `src/lmstudio.js` to ensure the agent outputs `<thought>` blocks and invokes tools continuously without waiting for human feedback. Also expanded the anti-loop rules to instruct the AI to handle failures autonomously.
2.  **Tool Prompt Reinforcement**: Updated Langchain tool descriptions (`write_file`, `run_in_bash_session`, `replace_with_git_merge_diff`) in `src/tools.js` with explicit commands like "Never ask for help" to prevent the LLM from trying to fall back to conversational assistance.
3.  **Fixes**: Fixed a subtle syntax error (`do so.\``) in the system prompt string that caused script compilation failures.

Tests and compilation (`node -c`, `test_robust_replace.cjs`) were verified.
